provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: المكوّن لا يأخذ اتجاهًا ولا يسمّي جهة فيزيائية
title.en: A component takes no direction and names no physical side

statement.ar: الاتجاه يُورَث من السياق (سمة dir على الجذر أو على نطاق). لا يوجد خاصية dir على المكونات، وأسماء الخصائص والقيم العامة تستخدم start وend.
statement.en: Direction is inherited from context (the dir attribute on the root or on a scope). Components have no dir prop, and public prop names and values use start and end.

rationale.ar: خاصية اتجاه على كل مكوّن تسمح بتناقض بين المكوّن وما حوله، وتُضاعف مساحة الاختبار.
rationale.en: A direction prop on every component allows a component to contradict its surroundings and doubles the test surface.

checks: No public component prop is named dir, rtl, left or right, and no prop value is "left" or "right" (except in components whose subject is physical, such as a text-alignment control).
Engines read direction from one context value, and every keyboard and placement test runs in both directions.
